title: manufacturing.plan input
description: The plans to work out, in order (a whole page's in one call): each a batch/lot record, the dose (mg TPE per unit), the units asked for and the certificate's figures (coa), or, for a make job queued before DOSE-25, the 2-place certificate TPE it was reviewed at (coa_tpe).

source.description: The state's harvest batch or process lot record; only analyteWeight (mg/g: a JSON number, anything else is no potency) and dryWeight (g, read as records::dry_grams reads it: one that isn't a plain number is 0 g) are read.

coa_tpe.description: Only for a make job queued before DOSE-25 (an item without coa): the certificate's TPE (mg/g) to 2 places as it was reviewed, or null; a value that isn't a JSON number of 0 or more counts as none, and is echoed back as given, except a figure that isn't finite (JSON can't carry one: text that reads as one, such as "inf", "-inf" or "nan", as the server hands it over), which is a refusal and is echoed as null.

coa.description: The certificate's figures (mg/g) the plan works its TPE out from (DOSE-25: the certificate's potency is the higher of its unrounded TPE and that TPE to 2 places; none when the 2-place figure isn't above 0), or null for no certificate: psilocybin, psilocybin_from ("state" when that psilocybin is the state's), psilocin and lab_tpe (the lab's printed total), read as coa.tpe reads them. A coa that isn't an object or null, a figure the TPE needs that isn't a number (a figure that isn't finite comes as its text, as plans.for_core hands it over), or a TPE that isn't finite is a refusal, its coa_tpe echoed as null. When present, coa_tpe is not read.
